name: preflight-acap
description: Scans an Axis camera subnet and reports which cameras survive an AXIS OS upgrade

scripts.build: node check-version.mjs && tsc && node -e "const f=require('fs');f.copyFileSync('src/rules.json','dist/rules.json');const k='src/licence-key.pub';if(f.existsSync(k)&&f.readFileSync(k,'utf8').includes('BEGIN PUBLIC KEY')){f.copyFileSync(k,'dist/licence-key.pub');console.log('licence verification: enabled')}else console.log('licence verification: DISABLED - no valid src/licence-key.pub, this build treats every key as unlicensed')"

author: Pavel Kotyza <kotyza@gmail.com>
